'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] announces the deaths of two of their commanders in [[Bakhmut]] and the village of Sontsivka west of [[Donetsk]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Bangladesh]] and [[Myanmar]] order massive [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]] as [[Cyclone Mocha]] makes landfall in both countries' coastal areas. Six people are killed in Myanmar, with about 90% of the city of [[Sittwe]] being destroyed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65587321 (BBC News)]
*At least 26 people are killed when a van crashes into a truck in [[Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-truck-van-accident-deaths-b3a8406373cfb9601d6219d23c05c807 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy to Europe]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] meets with [[Chancellor of Germany|German Chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65588111 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Turkish presidential election]], [[2023 Turkish parliamentary election]]
**[[Turkey|Turks]] head to the polls to elect a [[President of Turkey|president]] for a term of five years as well as the members of the [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Grand National Assembly]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/5/14/turkey-elections-2023-live-news-erdogan-in-tight-electoral-race (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Thai general election]]
**[[Thailand|Thai]]s head to the polls to elect the members of the [[House of Representatives (Thailand)|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2023-05-13/thai-election-underway-with-opposition-favored-to-top-polls (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Prime Minister of Belarus]] [[Roman Golovchenko]] addresses the nation on the anniversary of the [[1995 Belarusian referendum]], one day after it was reported that [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] had been hospitalised.
